opportunities.title: An AI Agent Just Found (and Weaponized) a Redis Zero-Day — Welcome to Autonomous Vuln Research
opportunities.why_now: Kimi K3 autonomously discovered Redis zero-days and built a working RCE exploit, a first-of-its-kind escalation in AI-driven offensive security.
opportunities.angle: Explainer + threat-model piece: walk through what Kimi K3 found, why Redis's trust model made it exploitable, and what this means for defenders who now face AI-speed vuln discovery — patch cadence section is a natural fit.

opportunities.title: Russian Hackers Are Inside Your Inbox: Zimbra Zero-Day Used to Steal Mail and 2FA Codes
opportunities.why_now: Active exploitation of an unpatched Zimbra flaw by a Russian espionage group against US and Ukrainian targets, with mail and 2FA token theft confirmed.
opportunities.angle: Breach digest entry with IOC/timeline breakdown and a 'patch now' callout — pair with CVE details and mitigation steps for Zimbra admins.

opportunities.title: One Default Azure Setting Away From Total Tenant Takeover
opportunities.why_now: A default Azure Automation configuration was shown to enable cross-tenant identity takeover, a severe cloud misconfiguration affecting countless orgs who never touched the setting.
opportunities.angle: Technical breakdown of the attack chain plus a checklist readers can run against their own tenants today — high-utility, shareable format.

opportunities.title: A Hacker Ran an AI Agent Unattended Inside Thailand's Finance Ministry — And It Worked
opportunities.why_now: Hermes AI agent was used to autonomously conduct post-exploitation inside a government finance ministry, a landmark case of hands-off AI-driven intrusion.
opportunities.angle: Threat-actor profile framed as 'the future of APT tradecraft' — cover the TTPs, why unattended agentic post-ex is a step-change, and what SOC detection needs to catch it.

opportunities.title: GitLab RCE PoC Lets Any Logged-In User Run Commands as Git — Patch This Weekend
opportunities.why_now: A public PoC now exists for authenticated RCE in GitLab, meaning exploitation is trivial and imminent for any unpatched instance.
opportunities.angle: Urgent patch-cadence alert: CVE details, affected versions, exploitation difficulty, and a hard deadline framing ('patch before Monday') to drive clicks from admins scrambling to check exposure.
